text: Okay, so I placed an order a little while back. I've got two watches in it. First off, I need to change the shipping address. It's for my New York place, but I'm not sure how to put that without giving it all out. Can you help me update that to a different address? I think I have it saved somewhere... let me see. Yeah, it's the one associated with my other order, but I don't want to use that one here. Any way to just change it generally to NY?
zh: 好的，所以我不久前下了一个订单。里面有 两块手表。首先，我需要更改收货地址。是给我的纽约住所，但我不确定如何写出来而不泄露所有信息。你能帮我更新地址吗？我想我把它保存 somewhere...让我看看。是的，它是与我的其他订单关联的，但我不想在这里使用那个。有没有办法直接更改为纽约？
